action_unit.primary_vs_secondary_axis_assignments: Each assignment needs a distinct trigger/organizing-role reason and quote; overlap is allowed but no independent-result double counting.

anchors.0: 在来源齐全、整体可识别且该轴自由度可用的主语境中，未观察到实质横向拓展。
anchors.1: 偶发地实际检查一个有动机的邻近对象、情境或问题，没有组织后续研究。
anchors.2: 将一个不同对象类、目标或相邻问题展开成有实质操作与解释的局部分支。
anchors.3: 扩展对象、情境或问题之间的关系组织一条持续实质主线，并影响后续比较或推导。
anchors.4: 以探索相连问题或范围作为中心策略，扩展或比较框架实际决定主要选题与取舍；一条统一对象族路线即可，不按分支数量升级。

exclusions: Lists of possible directions without action
Several values of the same routine example
Directions already explicitly required by a legacy task
axes.trigger: Changing or connecting substantive objects, contexts, target questions or problem families.

anchors.0: 在来源齐全、整体可识别且该轴自由度可用的主语境中，未观察到进一步纵向追查。
anchors.1: 对一个现象多追问一步并实际推导，但没有组织后续研究。
anchors.2: 深入一个局部机制、瓶颈或定量问题，形成从属于主议程的小路线。
anchors.3: 围绕同一核心问题持续追查机制、依赖或更精确说明，实际后续动作由该问题牵引。
anchors.4: 主要议程以追透一个机制或明确瓶颈为中心策略，形成可追踪的递进研究链；可以诚实停在未闭合处，不要求已证深度。

exclusions: Routine completion of a missing requested proof step
axes.trigger: Following a chosen core question into further mechanisms, dependencies, precision or a concrete bottleneck.

anchors.0: 在来源齐全、整体可识别且该轴自由度可用的主语境中，未观察到概念性重构。
anchors.1: 偶发实际试用一个不同视角，内容超过改记号。
anchors.2: 一个局部分支改换对象、表示、不变量或问题分解，并实际操作其关系。
anchors.3: 替代表示驱动持续主线的推导或探查，原对象与新表示的对应被实际提出并检验。
anchors.4: 概念重组是中心策略，可指出原问题、新表示、对应或障碍、后续路径选择的链；桥梁成立与否另记verification。

exclusions: More advanced terminology without a changed mathematical organization
axes.trigger: Changing the conceptual object, representation, invariant or problem decomposition and actually working through the relationship.

anchors.0: 在来源齐全、整体可识别且该轴自由度可用的主语境中，未观察到额外边界探查。
anchors.1: 偶发实际检查一个非必需端点、假设或反例候选。
anchors.2: 将一个条件、锐性或可行性问题系统展开成局部分支。
anchors.3: 条件放松、退化、必要性或障碍构成持续主线，实际影响后续主张或路线。
anchors.4: 研究主要围绕成立与不成立的分界组织，反例搜索或不可能性路线作为中心策略；是否得到严格障碍另记。

exclusions: R3 compulsory hypothesis audit without a discretionary research action
axes.trigger: Testing optional hypotheses, limiting or degenerate regimes, sharpness, feasibility, counterexample candidates or obstructions.

anchors.0: 在来源齐全、整体可识别且该轴自由度可用的主语境中，未观察到实际探索实验。
anchors.1: 偶发进行一次有问题指向且有实际结果的探索探针。
anchors.2: 一组局部试验具有可说明的设计、实际结果与解释，但不组织主要议程。
anchors.3: 有结构的实际试验支持持续主线，结果影响猜想、推导目标或后续检验。
anchors.4: 实验反馈是中心策略，实际探查、判断及再研究组织关键问题或路径；一个短而完整的循环即可，样本量或工具次数不升级。

exclusions: Unexecuted code or an unexecuted experimental plan without observed outcomes
axes.trigger: Actual informative numerical, symbolic, finite-enumeration or structured manual probes with a concrete question and observed outcomes.

construct.meaning: Observed organizing roles of discretionary research actions in one invited task; not research capability, quality, unsolicited initiative or a stable preference estimate.

counting.main_null: Retain observed-fragment count and coverage; support/difference relation counts remain null. Do not infer a main grade from supplemental observations.
counting.partition_total_applies_when: main axis is numeric and all27families have completed screening

cross_task_corroboration.neutral_revisions: excluded because invitations and loss sets differ

per_axis_family_labels.difference: Main axis=0and another task contains an actual substantive autonomous fragment on this axis. Means observed in a different context, not a refuted preference.
per_axis_family_labels.insufficient: Required-only/no eligible action, constrained opportunity, missing source or unresolved review; reason retained.
per_axis_family_labels.support: Main axis>0and another task contains an actual substantive autonomous fragment on this axis. No claim of the same0to4intensity.

cross_task_corroboration.requiredness: Strictly outside actual required goals and necessary dependencies; use task request and frozen boundaries, never prior grades.
cross_task_corroboration.same_root_repetitions: Tag common independence_cluster across tasks/rounds; cross-task occurrence is not independent replication or cross-domain stability.
cross_task_corroboration.source: Rule-selected A1 and its explicit/admitted same-attempt delivery only.
cross_task_corroboration.stronger_result_dual_use: Allowed only with a substantive independently useful extra question; serving the original proof alone neither includes nor excludes it.

main_anchor.centrality_test: Removing this class of research action would materially change the principal agenda/path organization, not merely remove one example. This is a behavioral classification test, never mathematical error deletion.
main_anchor.evidence: Exact adopted trajectory/first selected delivery of each round, explicit delivered companions and already-admitted same-attempt cutoff evidence.
grade3_4_required_chain: explain influence on subsequent research choices
main_anchor.grade4_extra_requirement: Explain and evidence central agenda/path organizing role.
main_anchor.kind: one common independently-open three-round research trajectory
main_anchor.organization_judgment: One source-bound holistic organizational-role judgment per axis over the entire actual trajectory.
main_anchor.scope: Discretionary in-task choices are eligible; no requirement to exceed hidden capacity directions.

R1.exclusion: Routine delivery/well-definedness alone is not orientation; specific in-task choices may be.
required_delivery: separation of established and unestablished ideas

R2.exclusion: The expansion/deepening invitation is recorded and never relabeled unsolicited initiative.

delegated_choices: whether a concrete new probe/reframing is useful
R3.exclusion: Routine checks, pruning, rewriting and retained-only content do not create a new exploratory action.

overlap.example: Changing a hypothesis and actually enumerating counterexamples can support boundary and experimental roles; a notation change alone cannot support several axes.
overlap.one_episode_multiple_axes: Allowed only with separate actual mathematical triggers and organizing-role evidence; identify one shared episode, not multiple independent achievements.
overlap.same_axis_repeat_rule: No upgrade from restatements, splitting one chain into many units, or round repetition.

prior_context_disclosure: Post-observation descriptive assessment. The rubric proposer had prior evaluation context; the coordinator read source contracts and three A1 boundary examples before freezing. No model-level five-axis grades were created before this freeze. Existing public or private scores do not determine this rubric.
